column1: # Licence texts for packages that publish none inside the crate archive.
# Some publishers ship no LICENSE file in the .crate at all. cargo-about answers
# that by substituting a canonical SPDX template whose copyright line is still
# the literal placeholder `Copyright (c) <year> <copyright holders>`, at debug
# level, so the result looks like a finished notice. FerriteCAD refuses that
# substitution and takes the text from the upstream repository instead, at the
# exact commit the crate records in its own .cargo_vcs_info.json.
# Every row binds one package identity to one text through facts that can all be
#   * the registry checksum must equal the one Cargo.lock pins;
#   * the vcs commit must equal the one inside the published crate;
#   * the payload under tools/notices/texts/ must hash to text_sha256.
# tools/refresh-notice-texts.sh is what writes this file, and it is the only
# script that goes online. tools/generate-rust-notices.sh only reads it, and
# runs cargo `--frozen`, so an ordinary build and an ordinary gate never contact
#   source  name  version  registry_checksum  licence  repository  vcs_commit  repo_path  text_sha256
